name: Carlotta Alonso
source:
The lead soprano of the opera.

She hails from back alleys of Seville, Spain. She came to Paris by herself at the age of 12, attaining fame and glory through hard work and sheer effort.

She is an outstanding actress, capable of playing a variety of roles. 

She looked after Christine when the latter first came to the opera house. 

She likes oranges.
